plan.summary:
This change makes `joinPath` trim each path segment before it removes empty segments and joins them with `/`. Now `" a "` and `"a"` join the same way, and whitespace-only segments are dropped.

- `src/paths.ts`: add `.map((part) => part.trim())` before `filter(Boolean)`.
- `tests/paths.test.ts`: new test for trimming and for dropping a blank segment.
- `package.json`: add the new test file to the `test` script.
plan.riskRationale: This is a small change to one pure string function. It has a direct test and the test is added to the test script.
plan.storyArc: The fix is one line in `joinPath`. The new test shows the intended result for padded and blank segments. The `package.json` change makes the test script run that new test file.

topics.title: Trim segments in joinPath
topics.narrativeBrief: How does `joinPath` now handle padded and blank segments? Connect the added `trim` step to the test example `[' a ', 'b', '  ']` that gives `'a/b'`.

topics.title: Run the new paths test
topics.narrativeBrief: Does the `test` script now include the new paths test file? Verify the added path in the script. This hunk has runtime effect on the test run, so it is not noise.
